_design: THE UNESCO PROFILE — the base fact-sheet of the tenant: what SAP is installed, what is really implemented, what actually runs, and HOW it is operated. This is the FIRST thing a session (or an external reviewer) needs; the capability_model (L15) then says how well we KNOW each domain. Profile = the system; capability_model = our knowledge of it. Do not merge them, do not duplicate them.
_why_it_exists: s097: answering an external Business-Process-Review questionnaire exposed that 'what is installed / implemented / used' lived nowhere — it had to be re-derived from cvers + audit logs mid-conversation, and the first answer was WRONG on 5 modules (RE-FX, SD, FI-AA, PM, TRM-deals all reported as 'not evidenced' when all 5 are productive). The operating model (80.6% external) existed but was not wired to the bootstrap index. Root cause: no profile artifact. Fixed here.

_evidence_tiers.INSTALLED: component present in CVERS. Says nothing about use — most ECC components ship by default.
_evidence_tiers.CONFIGURED: organisational structure / customising exists (company code, sales org, plant, asset cocd...).
_evidence_tiers.PRODUCTIVE: business documents exist AND/OR the transactions are executed in the audit log.

operating_model.headline: UNESCO does NOT operate SAP by dialog. 80.6% of business RFC traffic is driven by EXTERNAL satellite applications. SAP is a read-dominant SYSTEM-OF-RECORD that feeds satellites and receives concentrated writes.
operating_model.stability: STRUCTURAL, not a spike — holds every month once our own extraction footprint is excluded.
operating_model.process_coverage: 91.1% of business RFC calls mapped to a process (2-axis engine: process x origin).

MuleSoft.what: SAP <-> PPM/Salesforce (Core Manager / Core Planner) project-financials sync

Named_user_portal.what: THE WRITE CHANNEL — transactions and master changes enter under a named user's ID

RFC_SSIS.what: Microsoft SSIS BI extractor reading SAP tables raw

operating_model.still_dialog: vendor master change (XK02, dual-channel with the BAPI), GL master (FS00, rare), bank master (FI01), some FI postings. Dialog is a MINORITY for P2P, Travel, FM/Project master and HR-org.

digital_front_end._why_it_matters: A 'Digital Transformation' review must know the digital front-end that ALREADY exists. This layer was absent from the first module answer entirely.
digital_front_end.hcm_fiori_self_service: full SAP Fiori for HCM set registered: HCMFAB_MYPERSONALDATA / MYPAYSTUBS / MYBENEFITS / MYADDRESSES / MYBANKDETAILS / MYFAMILYMEMBERS / MY_MEDICAL_INFO / MYFORMS / PROCESS_INBOX / START_PROCESS, plus HRESS_* (ESS) and HRMSS_* (MSS: approvals, substitution, notes)
digital_front_end.characterisation: The digital front-end is almost ENTIRELY HR (employee & manager self-service + benefits + offboarding + forms). Finance/procurement have NO Fiori footprint - they are served by the external satellite portals instead.
digital_front_end.limit: REGISTERED and ACTIVE is measured; actual CALL VOLUME is not - /IWFND/SU_STATS is not readable via RFC here. Do not claim adoption from this.

users_and_licences.dormancy: 2,130 of 6,752 users (31.5%) have logged on since 1 Jan 2026 - i.e. ~68% show no logon in the last ~7 months. Locked/expired accounts were NOT separated out; treat as a flag to investigate, not a licence saving yet.
users_and_licences.warning: LIC_TYPE codes are CONTRACTUAL - AZ/AX/AY/BK/BA are UNESCO-specific codes whose meaning lives in the SAP licence agreement, NOT in the system. Never guess what they map to; ask for the contract.

_probe_negative_contract.TABLE_NOT_AVAILABLE_is_NOT_absence: RFC_READ_TABLE returns key=TABLE_NOT_AVAILABLE on P01 for tables that demonstrably exist and hold data (FMBH -> 294,098 rows in the Gold DB; FMRESERV -> 6.4M change docs; also FM01, HRFPM_*, T093C, T703P, USR02 without narrow FIELDS). It is an ACCESS/read restriction, never proof the table or the module is missing. When it fires: fall back to the Gold DB, to cdhdr, or to rsau_audit_history (execution evidence) before concluding anything.

technical_component_names._source: RESOLVED FROM THE SYSTEM 2026-07-28, not from memory: TADIR(obj->DEVCLASS) -> TDEVC(DEVCLASS->COMPONENT/FCTR_ID) -> DF14L(FCTR_ID->PS_POSID). Anchor object in brackets.
